agent_notes: No source found anywhere (20 web searches across hi/en, Chakdo/Chakro/चकड़ो/चकरो spellings, news/social/video/image/book/gov channels) that names 'Chakdo' directly. Rajasthan District Gazetteer (Sehgal, 1962, archive.org full text) and a Rajasthan govt panchayat PDF were checked and do not contain the name in any spelling. Patrika has run several retrospective pieces on the 34 villages displaced for Mahajan Field Firing Range (1984-85, 3.37 lakh acres) but they only name a handful of villages each time (Bhojrasar, Kumbhana, Motlai, Khaniser, Thoiya, Manera, Duder, Khajuwala, Dantor/Dantaur, Pugal, Mohangadh, Nachna) and Chakdo is never among them. This matches the unit's own note that the name comes solely from a Facebook comment-list image with blank positions 33-34 - it remains unverified. Recommend treating as low-confidence until a primary list (1982-84 land acquisition notification, gazette, or a longer Patrika/Rajasthan Patrika feature naming all 34) turns up.
